tool_schemas.name: add-project
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Todoist project for the authenticated account and updates the local mirror with the created project record. Returns the created project as stored in the mirror. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required project fields are missing or invalid, UNAUTHORIZED when the account token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the token lacks access to create projects, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are reached.

tool_schemas.name: get-projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects in the local mirror for the authenticated Todoist account and returns a collection of project records. Results are returned as a single, unpaged list. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the account token is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the token cannot access the workspace.

tool_schemas.name: get-project
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single project from the local mirror by its project identifier and returns the mirrored project record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the project identifier is missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND when no mirrored project exists for that account and id, UNAUTHORIZED when the account token is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN when the token does not have access to that project.

tool_schemas.name: update-project
tool_schemas.description: Updates a Todoist project and synchronizes the local mirror, returning the updated mirrored project record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the project id or update fields are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND when the project does not exist in the mirror for that account, CONFLICT when the project is deleted/archived in a way that prevents the requested update, UNAUTHORIZED when the account token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the token lacks permission to modify the project, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are reached.

tool_schemas.name: delete-project
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a Todoist project and marks it deleted in the local mirror, returning confirmation of deletion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the project id is missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND when the project does not exist for that account, CONFLICT when the project is already deleted, UNAUTHORIZED when the account token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the token lacks permission to delete the project, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are reached.

tool_schemas.name: get-project-collaborators
tool_schemas.description: Lists collaborators for a given project and returns the set of collaborator entries associated with that project in the mirror. Results are returned as a single, unpaged list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the project id is missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND when the project does not exist for that account, UNAUTHORIZED when the account token is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN when the token does not have access to view collaborators for the project.

tool_schemas.name: add-task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new task in Todoist (including dueDatetime, deadlineDate, deadlineLang, and durationUnit when provided) and updates the local mirror with the created task record. Returns the created task as stored in the mirror. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required task fields or date/duration formats are invalid, NOT_FOUND when a referenced project/section/parent task does not exist in the mirror for that account, CONFLICT when the requested placement is incompatible with the task state (for example, adding under a deleted parent), UNAUTHORIZED when the account token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the token lacks permission to add tasks in the target project, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are reached.

tool_schemas.name: quick-add-task
tool_schemas.description: Creates a task using Todoist-style natural language input, then updates the local mirror and returns the created mirrored task. If the natural language includes project/section/labels/dates, they are applied as parsed by Todoist and reflected in the returned task. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the input is missing or cannot be parsed into a valid task, NOT_FOUND when the parsed target project/section does not exist or is not accessible for that account, UNAUTHORIZED when the account token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the token lacks permission to add tasks, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when write limits are reached.

tool_schemas.name: get-task
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single task from the local mirror by account_id and task_id and returns the mirrored task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when account_id or task_id is missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND when no mirrored task exists for that account and id, UNAUTHORIZED when the account token is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN when the token does not have access to the task’s project.

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID (tdacct_01H...) owning the mirrored task.

tool_schemas.name: get-tasks
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks from the local mirror for the given account_id, applying optional filters (project_id, section_id, parent_task_id, label, status, due/completed ranges) and returning tasks sorted by sort_by and sort_order. Results are paged with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor; the response returns up to limit tasks and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when filter values are malformed (including invalid date-time ranges, enums, or limit) or when cursor is invalid, UNAUTHORIZED when the account token is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN when the token does not have access to the requested scope (for example, filtering to a project the user cannot access).

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID (tdacct_01H...) to query tasks for.

project_id.description: Filter tasks by local project ULID (tdprj_01H...).

section_id.description: Filter tasks by local section ULID (tdsec_01H...).

parent_task_id.description: Filter tasks by local parent task ULID (tdtsk_01H...).

label.description: Filter tasks that contain this label name in their labels array.

due_from.description: Filter tasks with due_date at or after this timestamp.

due_to.description: Filter tasks with due_date before or at this timestamp.

completed_from.description: Filter tasks completed at or after this timestamp.

completed_to.description: Filter tasks completed before or at this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-tasks-completed-by-completion-date
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks in the account’s mirrored workspace that were completed between completed_from and completed_to (both inclusive), optionally filtered by project_id and/or tasks that contain the given label name, sorted by completed_at in the requested sort_order. Returns up to limit tasks and a next-page cursor when more results exist; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the time range is invalid, limit is out of bounds, or cursor is malformed; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller can’t access the account mirror; NOT_FOUND if account_id (or provided project_id) doesn’t exist in the mirror.

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID (tdacct_01H...) to query completed tasks for.

project_id.description: Optional filter by local project ULID (tdprj_01H...).

label.description: Optional filter for tasks containing this label name.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-tasks-completed-by-due-date
tool_schemas.description: Lists completed tasks in the account’s mirrored workspace whose due_date falls between due_from and due_to (both inclusive), optionally filtered by project_id and/or tasks that contain the given label name, sorted by due_date in the requested sort_order. Returns up to limit tasks and a next-page cursor when more results exist; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the time range is invalid, limit is out of bounds, or cursor is malformed; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller can’t access the account mirror; NOT_FOUND if account_id (or provided project_id) doesn’t exist in the mirror.

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID (tdacct_01H...) to query completed tasks for.

due_from.description: Start of due_date range (inclusive) for tasks that are completed.

due_to.description: End of due_date range (inclusive) for tasks that are completed.

project_id.description: Optional filter by local project ULID (tdprj_01H...).

label.description: Optional filter for tasks containing this label name.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-productivity-stats
tool_schemas.description: Aggregates completed tasks in the account’s mirrored workspace over the inclusive [from, to] window into day/week/month buckets per group_by, optionally filtered by project_id and/or tasks that contain the given label name. Returns the bucketed counts (and corresponding bucket timestamps) for the requested range with no pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if from/to are invalid, from is after to, or group_by is not supported; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller can’t access the account mirror; NOT_FOUND if account_id (or provided project_id) doesn’t exist in the mirror.

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID (tdacct_01H...) to compute stats for.

from.description: Start timestamp (inclusive) for considering completed tasks.

to.description: End timestamp (inclusive) for considering completed tasks.

group_by.description: Time bucket size used to aggregate completed tasks.

project_id.description: Optional filter by local project ULID (tdprj_01H...).

label.description: Optional filter for tasks containing this label name.

tool_schemas.name: update-task
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing task (content, description, priority, labels, due/deadline/duration fields) by enqueueing the change to Todoist and updating the local mirror for the given account_id/task_id. Returns the updated mirrored task once the update is accepted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any provided field is invalid (e.g., priority out of 1–4, duration_unit not in {minute, day}, or due/deadline timestamps malformed) or if required paired fields are inconsistent (e.g., duration_unit without duration_amount); UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller can’t modify the account; NOT_FOUND if account_id or task_id does not exist in the mirror; CONFLICT if the task is in a state that cannot be updated (e.g., already deleted).

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID (tdacct_01H...) owning the task.

labels.description: Updated set of label names for the task.

due_date.description: Updated due timestamp (or null to clear).

due_lang.description: Updated language code for interpreting due strings (if applicable).

deadline_date.description: Updated deadline timestamp (or null to clear).

duration_amount.description: Updated duration amount for the task.

duration_unit.description: Updated duration unit for the task.

tool_schemas.name: close-task
tool_schemas.description: Marks the specified task as completed by enqueueing a close operation to Todoist and recording the completion in the local mirror. Returns the updated mirrored task (or completion state) reflecting that it is closed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller can’t modify the account; NOT_FOUND if account_id or task_id does not exist in the mirror; CONFLICT if the task is already closed or has been deleted and cannot be transitioned to closed.

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID (tdacct_01H...) owning the task.

tool_schemas.name: move-tasks
tool_schemas.description: Moves the given task_ids by enqueueing a move to Todoist and updating the local mirror to reflect the new location in a destination project_id and/or section_id and/or parent_task_id. Returns the moved tasks (or a move result) for the batch, and only moves tasks that pass validation for the requested destination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if task_ids is empty, if no destination is provided, or if destination identifiers are malformed; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller can’t modify the account; NOT_FOUND if account_id, any task_id, or any provided destination (project/section/parent) doesn’t exist in the mirror; CONFLICT if the requested move is not allowed (e.g., moving a task under itself/its descendant, moving into a section that does not belong to the destination project, or moving tasks that are deleted).

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID (tdacct_01H...) owning the tasks.

task_ids.description: List of local task ULIDs (tdtsk_01H...) to move.

section_id.description: Destination local section ULID (tdsec_01H...) within the destination project.

parent_task_id.description: Destination local parent task ULID (tdtsk_01H...) to nest tasks under.

tool_schemas.name: delete-task
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified task by enqueueing a delete operation to Todoist and marking it deleted in the local mirror for the given account. Returns a deletion acknowledgement (and/or the task’s updated deleted state) once accepted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id or task_id fails the expected ULID pattern; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller can’t modify the account; NOT_FOUND if account_id or task_id does not exist in the mirror; CONFLICT if the task is already deleted and cannot be deleted again.

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID for the workspace mirror to operate on.

tool_schemas.name: reopen-task
tool_schemas.description: Reopens a previously completed task by enqueueing a reopen operation to Todoist and updating the local mirror to mark it not completed. Returns the updated mirrored task (or reopen state) reflecting that it is open. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id or task_id fails the expected ULID pattern; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller can’t modify the account; NOT_FOUND if account_id or task_id does not exist in the mirror; CONFLICT if the task is not currently completed or has been deleted and cannot be reopened.

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID for the workspace mirror to operate on.

task_id.description: Local task ULID to reopen (mark as not completed).

tool_schemas.name: get-tasks-by-filter
tool_schemas.description: Lists tasks from the account’s mirrored workspace matching the provided Todoist filter expression, optionally including completed tasks when include_completed is true, and applies the requested sort and sort_direction. Returns up to limit tasks and a next-page cursor when more results exist; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filter is empty, limit is out of bounds, cursor is malformed, or sort/sort_direction are unsupported; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller can’t access the account mirror; NOT_FOUND if account_id does not exist in the mirror.

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID for the workspace mirror to query.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort.description: Sort key applied to the filtered tasks.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for the chosen sort key.

include_completed.description: Whether to include completed tasks in results (if available in the mirror/index).

tool_schemas.name: add-section
tool_schemas.description: Adds a new section with the given name (and optional order) to the specified project by enqueueing the creation to Todoist and inserting the section into the local mirror. Returns the newly created mirrored section. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/project_id are malformed, name is empty, or order is out of range; UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller can’t modify the account; NOT_FOUND if account_id or project_id does not exist in the mirror; CONFLICT if a section with the same identity cannot be created due to a project state that forbids changes (e.g., project deleted).

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID for the workspace mirror to operate on.

project_id.description: Local project ULID to add the section to.

order.description: Optional section order/position within the project.

tool_schemas.name: get-section
tool_schemas.description: Returns the section record from the local workspace mirror for the given account_id and section_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if either id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the account or section does not exist in the mirror or the section is not owned by the account, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read that workspace.

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID for the workspace mirror to query.

tool_schemas.name: get-sections
tool_schemas.description: Lists sections in the given mirrored project and returns up to limit items sorted by sort and sort_direction; pagination uses cursor, where the response includes a next_cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, limit/cursor, or unsupported sort options, NOT_FOUND if the account or project is missing or the project is not in the account, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the workspace.

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID for the workspace mirror to query.

project_id.description: Local project ULID whose sections should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of sections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include sections with status=deleted.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for the chosen sort key.

tool_schemas.name: update-section
tool_schemas.description: Queues an update to Todoist for the section (name and/or order) and updates the local mirror once the change is accepted, returning the updated section. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if no updatable fields are provided or values are invalid (e.g., empty name, negative order), NOT_FOUND if the account or section does not exist or is not owned by the account, CONFLICT if the section is deleted and cannot be updated, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks write access.

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID for the workspace mirror to operate on.

order.description: New section order/position within the project.

tool_schemas.name: delete-section
tool_schemas.description: Queues deletion of the section in Todoist and marks the section as deleted in the local mirror, returning the deleted section (or a deletion acknowledgement) for the requested section_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, NOT_FOUND if the account or section does not exist or is not owned by the account, CONFLICT if the section is already deleted, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to modify the workspace.

account_id.description: Todoist account ULID for the workspace mirror to operate on.

tool_schemas.name: add-comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment on exactly one target (task_id or project_id), queues the write to Todoist, and returns the created mirrored comment including any stored attachment payload. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if both or neither of task_id/project_id are provided or content is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the account or target task/project is missing or not owned by the account, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the workspace or cannot comment on the target.

account_id.description: Todoist account id to act under (tdacct_01H... ULID).

task_id.description: Local task id to attach the comment to (tdtsk_01H... ULID); provide either task_id or project_id.

project_id.description: Local project id to attach the comment to (tdprj_01H... ULID); provide either project_id or task_id.

attachment.description: Optional attachment payload to store with the comment.

tool_schemas.name: get-comment
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single comment from the local mirror by comment_id, optionally allowing deleted comments when include_deleted=true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, NOT_FOUND if the account or comment does not exist, if the comment is deleted and include_deleted is false, or if the comment is not owned by the account, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the workspace.

account_id.description: Todoist account id owning the comment (tdacct_01H... ULID).

comment_id.description: Local comment id to fetch (tdcmt_01H... ULID).

include_deleted.description: Whether to allow returning comments marked deleted in the local mirror.

tool_schemas.name: get-comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists mirrored comments for exactly one target (task_id or project_id) or, if neither is provided, lists comments across the workspace for the account; returns up to limit results ordered by sort and paged with cursor/next_cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if both task_id and project_id are provided or if limit/cursor/sort/status are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the account or specified target does not exist or is not owned by the account, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks read access.

account_id.description: Todoist account id to query within (tdacct_01H... ULID).

task_id.description: Filter to comments for a specific local task (tdtsk_01H... ULID); provide either task_id or project_id.

project_id.description: Filter to comments for a specific local project (tdprj_01H... ULID); provide either project_id or task_id.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: update-comment
tool_schemas.description: Queues an update to Todoist for the comment (content and/or attachment) and returns the updated mirrored comment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if no updatable fields are provided or values are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the account or comment does not exist or is not owned by the account, CONFLICT if the comment is deleted and cannot be updated, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to modify comments in the workspace.

account_id.description: Todoist account id owning the comment (tdacct_01H... ULID).

comment_id.description: Local comment id to update (tdcmt_01H... ULID).

attachment.description: Replacement attachment payload for the comment.

tool_schemas.name: delete-comment
tool_schemas.description: Queues deletion of the comment in Todoist and marks the comment as deleted in the local mirror, returning the deleted comment (or a deletion acknowledgement). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, NOT_FOUND if the account or comment does not exist or is not owned by the account, CONFLICT if the comment is already deleted, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks write access.

account_id.description: Todoist account id owning the comment (tdacct_01H... ULID).

comment_id.description: Local comment id to delete (tdcmt_01H... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: get-task-comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments from the local mirror for a specific task_id filtered by status, sorted by sort, and paged with limit and cursor (the response includes next_cursor when more results exist). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids or invalid paging/sort/status parameters, NOT_FOUND if the account or task does not exist or is not owned by the account, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read the workspace or task.

account_id.description: Todoist account id to query within (tdacct_01H... ULID).

task_id.description: Local task id to fetch comments for (tdtsk_01H... ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get-project-comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments for the specified mirrored project and returns up to `limit` results ordered by `sort`, with pagination via an opaque `cursor` that you pass to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `status`, `sort`, `limit`, or `cursor` is invalid; NOT_FOUND if the `account_id` or `project_id` does not exist (or does not belong to the account); and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to access that account’s workspace.

account_id.description: Todoist account id to query within (tdacct_01H... ULID).

project_id.description: Local project id to fetch comments for (tdprj_01H... ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: add-label
tool_schemas.description: Enqueues adding the specified label to the specified task in Todoist and updates the local mirror to reflect the change, returning the updated task (including its label set). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any id is malformed; NOT_FOUND if the `account_id`, `task_id`, or `label_id` cannot be found under that account; CONFLICT if the task is deleted or the label is already present on the task; and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to modify that account’s tasks.

account_id.description: Todoist account id to act under (tdacct_01H... ULID).

task_id.description: Local task id to add the label to (tdtsk_01H... ULID).

label_id.description: Local label id to add to the task (tdlbl_01H... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: delete-label
tool_schemas.description: Enqueues deletion of the specified label in Todoist and marks the label as deleted in the local mirror, returning the deleted label record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed; NOT_FOUND if the `account_id` or `label_id` does not exist under that account; CONFLICT if the label is already deleted; and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to manage labels for the account.

account_id.description: Todoist account id owning the label (tdacct_01H... ULID).

label_id.description: Local label id to delete (tdlbl_01H... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: update-label
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields (`name`, `color`, `is_favorite`) for the specified label by enqueueing the change to Todoist and updating the mirrored label, returning the updated label. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if provided fields are invalid (including an unknown `color`) or no updatable fields are supplied; NOT_FOUND if the `account_id` or `label_id` does not exist under that account; CONFLICT if the label is deleted; and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to update labels for the account.

account_id.description: Todoist account id owning the label (tdacct_01H... ULID).

label_id.description: Local label id to update (tdlbl_01H... ULID).

color.description: New label color (Todoist color identifier as stored in mirror).

is_favorite.description: Whether the label should be marked as favorite.

tool_schemas.name: get-label
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single label from the local mirror for the given account and returns the label record (including its current mirrored status). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed; NOT_FOUND if the `account_id` or `label_id` does not exist under that account; and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read that account’s labels.

account_id.description: Todoist account id owning the label (tdacct_01H... ULID).

label_id.description: Local label id to fetch (tdlbl_01H... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: get-labels
tool_schemas.description: Lists labels in the account from the local mirror, applying the provided filters and returning up to `limit` results sorted by `sort`/`order`, with pagination via an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter, sort/order, limit, or cursor is invalid; NOT_FOUND if the `account_id` does not exist; and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read that account’s labels.

account_id.description: Todoist account id whose labels to list (tdacct_01H... ULID).

is_shared.description: Filter by whether labels are shared.

is_favorite.description: Filter by whether labels are favorited.

limit.description: Maximum number of labels to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-shared-labels
tool_schemas.description: Lists shared-label records for the account from the local mirror, returning up to `limit` results sorted by `sort`/`order` and paged using an opaque `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `status`, sort/order, limit, or cursor is invalid; NOT_FOUND if the `account_id` does not exist; and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read that account’s shared-label metadata.

account_id.description: Todoist account id whose shared labels to list (tdacct_01H... ULID).

status.description: Filter shared labels by mirrored status.

limit.description: Maximum number of shared labels to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: remove-shared-label
tool_schemas.description: Enqueues removal of a shared label in Todoist and updates the local mirror so the shared-label record is removed/marked deleted, returning the resulting shared-label state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed; NOT_FOUND if the `account_id` or `label_id` does not exist under that account; CONFLICT if the shared label is already removed/deleted; and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to manage shared labels for the account.

account_id.description: Todoist account id owning the shared label (tdacct_01H... ULID).

label_id.description: Local label id of the shared label to remove (tdlbl_01H... ULID).

tool_schemas.name: rename-shared-label
tool_schemas.description: Enqueues a rename for the specified shared label in Todoist and updates the local mirror, returning the updated shared-label record (and its associated label name). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is empty/invalid or ids are malformed; NOT_FOUND if the `account_id` or `label_id` does not exist under that account; CONFLICT if the shared label is removed/deleted; and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to manage shared labels for the account.

account_id.description: Todoist account id owning the shared label (tdacct_01H... ULID).

label_id.description: Local label id of the shared label to rename (tdlbl_01H... ULID).

name.description: New name for the shared label.

tool_schemas.name: get-whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated identity for the current integration context, including the linked Todoist account record, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for this backend. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the account token is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN when the token is not permitted to access identity details.

include_quota.description: When true, includes current quota/rate-limit usage and reset timestamps if available. Defaults to true.

metadata.name: Todoist Integration
metadata.description: This backend stores a local mirror of a user's Todoist workspace (projects, sections, tasks, comments, labels) plus collaboration/shared-label metadata needed to serve read APIs quickly and to track lifecycle changes like completion/reopen and deletion. Write tools enqueue changes to Todoist and upd
